# MCL 3.51a Congressional districts; division after January 1, 2013; numbering.
Sec. 1a. The state is divided into 14 congressional districts pursuant to the ratio of representation fixed under an act of congress for the apportionment of the representatives among the several states. Each district is entitled to 1 representative. For terms of office beginning on or after January 1, 2013, the districts are constituted and numbered as follows:
